#  **New Relic Picker Page**

<:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> **Website Link:** https://app.mothertree.workers.dev/relic-picker


Relic Picker helps you select the best damage relic for your team, assuming all relic effects are fully utilized. Hover over any relic to view its effect, or right click to open SkeyDB to see the full conditions.

Burst turn simulation follows the same rules as the search page. Check the search manual for details.
<:Study:1356053168257237133> **[Search Manual](https://app.mothertree.workers.dev/manual/search)**


###  **Instructions**
Step 1: Import your team. (Note: Morimens is buggy, so exported codes won't include bonded covenant. Readd them manually or export your team via SkeyDB.)

Step 2: Input your account level and the number of posse owned. Also, check the box if you're playing HSR.

Step 3: Click Calculate or check Auto-update.

Step 4: Pick relics following your run.

###  **Side Note**
I changed from Vercel to Cloudflare so the link looks different
